rules.message: Critical Kubernetes workload has fewer than two replicas
rules.recommendation: Use at least two replicas and distribute them across independent failure domains where the workload permits it.

rules.message: Kubernetes workload has incomplete resource requests or limits
rules.recommendation: Document CPU and memory requests and limits so scheduling and resource isolation can be reviewed.

rules.message: Kubernetes workload has incomplete health probes
rules.recommendation: Model readiness and liveness probes that separately represent traffic readiness and workload health.

rules.message: Critical stateless workload has no autoscaling fact
rules.recommendation: Document a HorizontalPodAutoscaler or explain why fixed capacity is intentional.

rules.message: Critical Kubernetes workload has no disruption budget
rules.recommendation: Add a PodDisruptionBudget aligned with the workload replica count and maintenance requirements.

rules.message: Kubernetes workload has no dedicated service account
rules.recommendation: Assign a dedicated ServiceAccount and bind only the API permissions required by the workload.

rules.message: Kubernetes namespace has no default network policy
rules.recommendation: Document default-deny ingress and egress policies, then add explicit workload traffic allowances.

rules.message: Kubernetes namespace has no protective Pod Security level
rules.recommendation: Apply and document an appropriate Baseline or Restricted Pod Security level.

rules.message: Public Kubernetes Service has no modeled Gateway or Ingress
rules.recommendation: Route public traffic through a documented Gateway or Ingress implementation and its security controls.

rules.message: StatefulSet has no persistent storage relationship
rules.recommendation: Connect the StatefulSet to a PersistentVolumeClaim or PersistentVolume and document StorageClass behavior.

rules.message: Critical StatefulSet has no backup fact
rules.recommendation: Document backup scope, retention, restore testing, and ownership for persistent data.
Add cluster and workload metrics, alerts, and centralized logs with clear operational ownership.
